name: Rounded cube w/ text and pips

captions.detailed: A 3D-printable six-sided game die with slightly rounded edges and corners. Each face contains indented spherical pips representing numbers 1 through 6, positioned in standard dice layouts. The overall structure is highly symmetric and compact, designed to roll smoothly.
captions.instruction: Create a parametric six-sided die in OpenSCAD. The user should be able to adjust the overall die size, the edge rounding radius, the depth and radius of the pip indentations, and optionally add text or numbers to the faces.
captions.factory: The script defines a 'die' module that subtracts pips and letters from a rounded cube. The rounded cube is generated using a difference operation between a standard cube and an array of extruded spheres positioned at the corners. Pips are created using sphere primitives translated and rotated to each of the six faces, while letters are placed using a writecube library helper.
